# Vetta 0.6.25
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-25 -->

## English

### New

- The app icon is now a glass droplet with glowing eyes on a blue background, in the Dock, taskbar, installer and windows. The blue binary icon from 0.6.24 is gone; if you used Default, you'll see the new icon after updating.
- Settings → Appearance → App icon adds Red, Black and Light versions of the new icon.

### Fixes

- In team conversations, switching models after hitting a usage limit now sticks, instead of quietly switching back and reporting the limit on every message until you start a new conversation.

## 中文

### 新增

- 应用图标换成蓝底的眼镜水滴，Dock、任务栏、安装包与窗口都会更新；0.6.24 的蓝底二进制图标不再提供，选「默认」的用户升级后直接看到新图标。
- 「设置 → 外观 → 应用图标」新增红色、黑色、浅色三款同款图标。

### 修复

- 团队对话撞到额度上限后换模型，不会再被悄悄改回原模型、每次发送都报额度用完，不用再新开对话。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.24...v0.6.25
